# Codeale - Desarrollo Web Moderno

Welcome to Codeale's LLM information page. Learn about our web development services and how we can help your project.

## About Us

Codeale is a web development agency specializing in modern, scalable applications built with React, Vite, and Node.js. We create performant, user-friendly web experiences.

## Services

We provide comprehensive web development solutions:

- **Custom Web Development** - Tailored solutions for your business needs
- **React & Vite Applications** - Modern frontend development with cutting-edge technologies
- **Full-Stack Solutions** - Complete backend and frontend integration
- **Performance Optimization** - Speed and efficiency improvements
- **SEO Optimization** - Search engine and AI optimization strategies

We work with modern technologies:

- React & Next.js
- Vite
- Node.js & Express
- PostgreSQL & MongoDB
- Docker & Cloud Deployment
